disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. Master Criteria, not DeepSeek's proposed log wording, defines the metric as NVRAS pass rate 100%. decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1916, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical record, pending/conflict analysis and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal locked-queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1920 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00465-V003 / 7c72f0f9a6dbd8e3.

The complete resolved manifest is the denominator. Every required case must PASS; skips, waived cases and infrastructure errors cannot silently enter the numerator or denominator unless the authoritative NVIDIA policy explicitly defines them.
Each case requires immutable baseline/stimulus/propagation/result evidence across NVRASTool, CPER, EDAC/rasdaemon, kernel, BMC and console; log clearing is prohibited by ED-17.
No package installation, NVRASTool launch, RAS injection, log clear, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Complete NVIDIA NVRASTool Grace RAS qualification with 100% NVRAS result
test_case.purpose: Execute the complete approved NVRASTool manifest for the exact Grace platform, correlate every observation or injected fault with expected containment and CPER/EDAC/BMC/OS evidence, and calculate the Master-authoritative NVRAS 100% result without hidden omissions.
required_package: Approved licensed NVRASTool artifact/version/hash/launcher and compatible rasdaemon version/configuration
Complete resolved required-case manifest and cited NVIDIA RAS/CPER/Debug/LibCper reference revisions
Per-case observation/injection taxonomy with component, severity, mechanism, expected propagation, timeout, abort and recovery
Isolated non-production configuration, preserved evidence storage, independent console/BMC/power/thermal/data-integrity monitoring and owner approval
test_case.test_command: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; after artifact, compatibility, full manifest, denominator and every injection contract are approved, collect immutable pre-test RAS/CPER/EDAC/rasdaemon/kernel/BMC baselines without clearing logs. Execute the documented vendor launcher serially for each required manifest case, only within its approved isolation/target/severity boundary, while preserving full stdout/stderr and independent console/power/thermal/data-integrity monitoring. Stop at the first unexpected fatal/uncorrectable behavior or evidence loss; do not retry. Collect post-state and calculate NVRAS passes divided by the complete authoritative required-case denominator. Read-only inventory alone is never qualification.
test_case.expected_result: Every required manifest case executes once and PASSes with the intended component/error/severity, documented injection acknowledgment when applicable, correct containment and expected CPER/EDAC/rasdaemon/kernel/BMC propagation, no unexpected reboot/data-integrity/power/thermal effect, complete immutable evidence and restored healthy state. NVRAS pass rate is exactly 100% with no hidden skip, waiver or infrastructure omission.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all authoritative required cases in the resolved denominator to PASS and the independently recalculated NVRAS rate to equal 100%, with complete per-case propagation and recovery evidence. FAIL on any case failure, unexpected severity/layer, skip/waiver not allowed by policy, incomplete evidence, unsafe injection, health/recovery issue or rate below 100%. BLOCKED at runtime when any package, manifest, compatibility, injection approval, denominator or recovery input is missing. DeepSeek GPG wording is ignored; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Do not launch until every injection-capable case, target, severity, isolation, abort and independent recovery is disclosed and approved.
Never inject fatal/uncorrectable/persistent faults outside the exact isolated authorization or continue after unexpected machine check, reboot or data-integrity concern.
Preserve all baseline and new RAS/CPER/EDAC/kernel/BMC evidence; never clear logs to create a clean baseline.
Use secure credentials/host verification, stop on monitoring/evidence loss and never automatically retry a suite or injection.
expected_evidence: Artifact/reference/firmware/kernel/rasdaemon identities, compatibility approval and complete resolved manifest
Immutable pre/during/post NVRASTool stdout/stderr, CPER, EDAC/rasdaemon, kernel, BMC and console evidence
Independent denominator table with every required PASS/FAIL/skip/error and recalculated 100% NVRAS rate
No-log-clear/no-auto-retry audit, restored platform/data health and engineer/end-user verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop immediately on unexpected uncorrectable/fatal error, machine check, reboot, data-integrity concern, lost console, thermal/power limit or evidence loss; preserve all partial evidence and do not retry. Use the per-case independently approved recovery, then verify RAS, storage/data, BMC, kernel and platform health before any further separately authorized case.
